strategy_question: How should the structurally occupied position 1 be prepared for OPI authoring when its only authorized source is the closed two-realization package VALI KE / PARAZAMI KE and no subject/person, tense/aspect, copula or translation expansion is licensed?

routes.name: SOURCE_PACKAGE_PRESERVING_OPI_ARTIFACT_DESIGN_FIRST
routes.reason: Design the bounded position-1 OPI artifact contract before writing content, preserving both authorized realizations and all semantic guards.

routes.name: SELECT_ONE_REALIZATION_AND_AUTHOR_IMMEDIATELY
routes.reason: Would collapse the already approved two-realization source package without an explicit design decision.

routes.name: FREE_AUTHORING_FROM_INTERROGATIVE_PATTERN
routes.reason: Would exceed the closed source package and risk inventing subject/person, translation or wider grammar.

constraints: No OPI text is authored in strategy selection.
No translation such as 'Do you work?' or 'Do you study?' is asserted without an explicit future semantic/pedagogical contract.
VALI KE and PARAZAMI KE remain the only authorized source realizations for position 1.
Selector 1 remains noncanonical and is not a slot ID or label.
No QA/STR003-STR005/runtime action and no KE generalization.
